exposure: Iatrogenic ureteral injury (from sigmoid colon resection and partial bladder resection)
cohort: Two patients with iatrogenic ureteral injuries, one occurring after sigmoid colon resection and partial bladder resection, and the other after a cesarean section.
finding: Methods of nonvascular interventional radiology can be successfully applied in the treatment of minor iatrogenic ureteral injuries.
mod_finding: One of the two iatrogenic ureteral injuries presented was identified as a result of a cesarean section.
